decision_status: PROPOSED — no path approved or launched

paths.title: Evidence-first, research-only
paths.description: Keep the existing fail-closed dashboard. Publish dated, source-linked facts and missing-data flags; no actionable picks, wager facilitation, cash prizes, or claims that luck has been removed.
paths.benefit: Matches the evidence currently present and does not require inventing prices, player status, depth order, or performance.
paths.tradeoff: No live edge, market comparison, rewards, or automatic injury adjustment is available yet.
paths.next_action: Build only the official-source coverage, timestamp, and error/flagging layer. Leave missing values blank.
paths.acceptance_criteria: Every published fact has an exact source and cutoff; stale/mismatched feeds fail closed; all strategy gates remain visible; no unverified line or reward is emitted.

paths.title: Automated shadow competition
paths.description: After source coverage and forecast-history gates pass, record immutable, timestamped, non-wagering forecasts for singles, parlays, and player-prop combinations; score them against a frozen baseline on an untouched chronological test.
paths.benefit: Creates an auditable basis to compare strategy skill rather than short-term realized wins, with explicit uncertainty and a points-only leaderboard.
paths.tradeoff: Requires permitted official data collection, complete outcomes, market/settlement evidence when evaluating value, aligned joint outcomes for combinations, enough independent time periods, and a functioning paper ledger.
paths.next_action: Do not start forecasts until G2–G8 applicable to the strategy are PASS and the data cutoff and evaluation family are preregistered.
paths.acceptance_criteria: Frozen rules; logged predictions before cutoff; appropriate outcome and price evidence; calibrated proper-score improvement with dependence-aware uncertainty and family-wide adjustment; reproducible settlement; zero cash/value prizes unless separately cleared.

paths.title: Real-money wagering or rewards of value
paths.status: HOLD — not recommended from current evidence
paths.description: Any future feature that takes, facilitates, settles, or promotes wagering, or awards cash, cash-equivalent, or other value, is outside this research-only release.
paths.benefit: Would require a separate product, operational, and regulatory decision; it is not a necessary step to research forecast skill.
paths.tradeoff: The project's legal classification, users, operator, jurisdiction, controls, and any required licences/approvals have not been established. The Singapore GRA pages are official review references, not a project-specific legal opinion.
paths.next_action: Keep this path disabled. If considered later, obtain qualified legal advice and regulator guidance for every relevant jurisdiction before product or prize implementation.
paths.acceptance_criteria: Written, product-specific legal/regulatory clearance, required authorizations and controls, independent risk review, and a separate approval decision. A model backtest alone cannot satisfy these conditions.

recommendations.title: Preserve the fail-closed baseline
recommendations.problem: The canonical audit is dated 2026-11-04; no fresh operator-native quotes or current Week 11 injury statuses were confirmed in this review.
recommendations.proposal: Keep market price, edge, probability, current availability, and reward cells blank unless their required evidence is verified. Display the source cutoff prominently and abstain when it is stale or mismatched.
recommendations.discovery_steps: Add a row-level freshness check and explicitly compare requested season/week with the returned source title and canonical URL. Record a review flag on a mismatch.
recommendations.acceptance_test: A simulated missing, stale, or wrong-week source leaves the value null and blocks every affected strategy; no stale value can silently flow into line output.

recommendations.title: Build a permitted, official-source capture registry
recommendations.problem: A dated static snapshot and scheduled software build are not a fresh data-ingestion service.
recommendations.proposal: Create one record per official source and field family: URL, publisher, event/week, observed-at time, source as-of time when available, coverage, checksum/version, parser checks, and failure reason. Automate refresh only where official access and terms permit; do not ask for manual rows or silently substitute non-official data.
recommendations.discovery_steps: Inventory official NFL/club/Next Gen Stats endpoints and publication timing; test a read-only capture for each field; document fields that cannot be reliably refreshed.
recommendations.acceptance_test: A clean scheduled run can report fresh/stale/failed coverage per field; a changed page or missing week is detected; unsupported fields remain null; no secrets enter the public artifact.

recommendations.title: Add an offense-and-defense replacement ledger
recommendations.problem: The injury report identifies player/position/practice/game status but does not itself provide depth tiers or a replacement mapping; no current verified depth relationships are stored.
recommendations.proposal: For each scheduled team/game and position group, store the official player ID, listed position, official availability fields, the dated official depth/starting source, role tier (starter/2nd/3rd/4th/unknown as Own8 schema), and an explicit `replaces_player_id` when the official source supports it. Cover QB, OL, RB, WR, TE and defensive front/edge, LB, CB, safety; retain an unknown/blank state for missing sources.
recommendations.discovery_steps: Use the NFL team directory to locate a team's own official publication; verify whether each team publishes a dated depth chart or explicit lineup, and record the source. Separately reconcile late injury/inactive information and actual game participation from an official source. Do not infer rank from roster listing order.
recommendations.acceptance_test: Every non-null depth tier and replacement link has an official, dated source; every team/unit with no source displays UNKNOWN; coverage checks include both offense and defense and all requested tiers; practice status never equals clearance.
recommendations.status: Proposed — no current roster values entered

recommendations.title: Separate descriptive lines from calibrated probabilities and market prices
recommendations.problem: The current B0 score mean is not a win/cover probability or a market price and has no roster or uncertainty calibration.
recommendations.proposal: Create distinct single-game models for spread, total, moneyline, and each player-prop family. Use only features available at the registered cutoff; publish the mean/distribution, calibration status, uncertainty, and abstention reason separately from any quote/edge.
recommendations.discovery_steps: Define target/outcome, eligible official features, cutoff, missing-data behavior, baseline, and uncertainty method for each market before fitting; document what source supports every input.
recommendations.acceptance_test: Each output can be reproduced from logged inputs; probability outputs are calibrated out of sample; unsupported inputs or prices remain blank; signs, pushes, ties, and line conventions are tested.

recommendations.title: Estimate and validate event-level dependence before parlays or prop combos
recommendations.problem: Current bet-event correlation rows have null values; team-aggregate correlations do not answer a wager-leg dependence question.
recommendations.proposal: For each pair and full combination, align game/player IDs, thresholds, times, outcomes, pushes/voids, and selection rules. Estimate event-level joint probabilities and uncertainty; validate the full joint event, not just a pairwise coefficient.
recommendations.discovery_steps: Start with named families (QB pass yards × receiver yards; team total × player prop; opposite-team rush/pass; cross-game legs). Build a source-backed event matrix and measure coverage before modeling.
recommendations.acceptance_test: The exact joint distribution is tested on an untouched time-ordered sample and is priced only with an exact verified offer/settlement rule; unknown dependence remains BLOCKED, never assumed zero.
recommendations.status: Proposed — all combination signals remain blocked

recommendations.title: Pre-register a chronological, multiplicity-aware validation protocol
recommendations.problem: No current canonical evidence establishes predictive skill; there are multiple strategy families and many possible feature/model variants.
recommendations.proposal: Freeze hypotheses, trial count, baseline, information cutoff, development folds, untouched test, metrics, exclusion rules, and reward formula before evaluation. Compare paired proper scores and calibration with time/game dependence-aware uncertainty; disclose every tested variant.
recommendations.discovery_steps: Write the protocol into versioned files before the next experiment; preserve a final season/time block that is not used for tuning; run a software test that rejects leakage and incomplete gate status.
recommendations.acceptance_test: A reproducible, untouched, source-backed result beats the frozen baseline by a predeclared conservative interval after the family-wide adjustment; otherwise the strategy remains blocked.
recommendations.status: Proposed — no skill claim or award

recommendations.title: Use a prospective paper ledger and points-only leaderboard after gates pass
recommendations.problem: The current leaderboard is an eight-strategy registry; it has no eligible rank, graded forecasts, or awarded rewards.
recommendations.proposal: Record every forecast immutably before kickoff with strategy version, inputs, timestamp, probability/line, applicable quote, and settlement rule. Show unranked entries until validation and sample gates pass; only then award non-transferable project points under a frozen scoring rule.
recommendations.discovery_steps: Specify tie handling, missing entries, correlated games, withdrawals, drawdowns, audit trail, and dispute/correction rules before accepting competition entries.
recommendations.acceptance_test: A paper forecast cannot be edited after cutoff without an append-only correction record; every leaderboard value recomputes from the ledger; no reward appears for a blocked strategy.
recommendations.status: Proposed — paper-only; not implemented in this module

recommendations.title: Keep cash/value rewards and wagering out of scope until cleared
recommendations.problem: The project's legal classification and prize structure are not established; official Singapore GRA guidance describes regulated betting and prize-related activities, but does not decide this project's status.
recommendations.proposal: Maintain a research-only, non-monetary leaderboard for now. Before any real-money wagering or award of cash, cash-equivalent, or another thing of value, obtain qualified advice and regulator guidance for relevant jurisdictions.
recommendations.discovery_steps: Document operator, users, service mechanics, chance/skill elements, entry/payment, prize form, and where the service is offered; then request product-specific review.
recommendations.acceptance_test: A separate signed-off legal/regulatory and operational review exists before code for payouts, deposits, or wagering facilitation is implemented.

recommendations.title: Add a source-of-truth catalog for the separate research workspaces
recommendations.problem: The repository contains the canonical root dashboard and additional research namespaces; not every workspace has a clearly verified live route/status in the root navigation.
recommendations.proposal: Maintain one module index with URL, owner/status, as-of date, evidence scope, and whether a page is canonical, auxiliary, historical, or archived. Link the same questions/flags only once, and keep shared data/navigation changes to a documented integration step.
recommendations.discovery_steps: Check each module’s owner handoff, Pages publication scope, current deployment, source coverage, and any unresolved flags. Record an explicit status instead of assuming a Git directory is live or verified.
recommendations.acceptance_test: Every linked module opens on Pages, states its date and verification scope, has no broken internal links, and does not silently duplicate or contradict canonical values.
recommendations.status: Proposed — live routes and module ownership need review
